Rubicon takes February.
A dead heat at the top, three ties in all, and every one of them settled by a single voter.
Nine of you ranked fourteen candidates this round. Rubicon (Holland) finished level with An Immense World on 89 points and took it on the head-to-head, in its first appearance on a ballot, and reads February.
Outcome Winner: Rubicon (89, on tiebreak)   ·   Runner-up: An Immense World (89)   ·   Relegated: The Eureka Machine, Born to Run, The River of Doubt, Easy Money

§ About those ties
Three pairs finished level: Rubicon and An Immense World on 89, The Black Count and The Man in the High Castle on 69, and Mayflower and Say Nothing on 68. The methodology calls for a Condorcet head-to-head first: ignore the rest of the ballot and ask how each voter ranked the two against one another.

All three pairs separated, and all three by the same 5–4 margin. Rubicon beat An Immense World and takes the book. The Black Count beat The Man in the High Castle for sixth, and Mayflower beat Say Nothing for eighth. No fall-through to first-place votes was needed.
